title: SDLC Task Design v1
description: The task-specific payload for policy-governed architecture, data-flow, interface, data-model, deployment, or related design work. Intent selects the applicable design policy and references authoritative inputs; result records the design model, policy outputs, verification obligations, and unresolved questions.
$comment: The common https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/task-envelope/v1 owns task identity, processing state, task routing, and the common task wrapper. This payload does not prescribe an architecture notation or fixed architecture collections. The design policy selected by intent determines which output categories and verification obligations are expected for the requested profile. JSON Schema validates local shape and reference syntax; the sdlc host must resolve global references, verify reference kinds and locators, check relation endpoints, verify view membership, and evaluate policy-derived coverage and semantic completeness.
